theorem.assumptions: A=I2(a),a>=4;B=I2(b),b>=6;x touches both A roots nonright;y has a specified contact label>=4 to Bj;all literal supports finite
theorem.cross_and_x_foreign: B has label>=6, so finite A+B and B+x force all cross pairs and x-B pairs right
theorem.y_foreign: In finite A+y+Bj any nonright y-A contact costs at least1/2 in A; the prescribed y-Bj contact costs at least1/2. Positive Schur complement is impossible, so y-A is right
theorem.xy_bound: The finite Ai-x-y-Bj path has determinant<=3/8-delta^2;label>=4 fails,so delta^2<=1/4
theorem.conclusion: The residual2x2 Gram is negative definite; the full Gram has at least two negative directions

scope: Sufficient all-label local obstruction. All unlisted contacts and dotted distances are free. It does not exclude the whole case5 incidence.
